commits.subject: [eas-simulator] read device logs and crash reports from an iOS session (#206)
commits.summary: Added iOS crash-diagnosis guidance for reading device logs and crash reports, including holding the log before reproducing a crash and keeping the session token private.

commits.subject: [eas-simulator] Carry tunnel authorization through live development (#204)
commits.summary: Clarified that existing authorization for the project's remote development transport should carry through tunnel creation, dev-client connection, and live edits, with its source and data flow stated in approval requests.

commits.subject: [eas-simulator] cover current CLI flags (#187)
commits.summary: Updated CLI guidance for current flags and session types, documented idle-timeout behavior and safer handling of existing sessions, and made each subcommand's `--help` authoritative.

commits.subject: [eas-simulator] Clarify EAS Simulator cost and authorization guidance (#186)
commits.summary: Revised cost, host-selection, access, authorization, and session-lifecycle guidance, including when to use local versus EAS simulators and when to stop or retain sessions.

commits.subject: [eas-simulator] Clarify tunnel approvals and recording recovery (#185)
commits.summary: Added references for tunnel scope and approval guidance and for recovering recordings from EAS session artifacts.

commits.subject: [eas-simulator] record video for motion; argent trimStatic/watermark, ffmpeg (#135)
commits.summary: Added video-recording guidance for motion and timing checks, described recording and frame-inspection caveats, and allowed the `ffmpeg` command.

commits.subject: [eas-simulator] Metro on its own port, stop forcing/killing :8081 (#133)
commits.summary: Changed the guidance to reuse Metro only if it was started in the current session, otherwise use a free port, and to stop only the agent's own Metro when resetting.

commits.subject: [skills] collect eval-candidate signals via new evals feedback category (#126)
commits.summary: Added instructions to use the expo-skill-feedback eval-candidate flow after repeated agent failures or when the user had to take over.

commits.subject: [eas-simulator] always pass --name to simulator:start (#125)
commits.summary: Required descriptive `--name` values for simulator sessions and added naming rules plus guidance on where session names appear.

commits.subject: [eas-simulator] flag the first-time deep-link Open dialog (#120)
commits.summary: Documented the first-time app deep-link confirmation dialog and how to confirm it with `agent-device press` using its own timeout.

commits.subject: [eas-simulator] check availability first, graceful fallback (#114)
commits.summary: Added a read-only access check before starting EAS sessions and a fallback to local alternatives when the account lacks access.

commits.subject: [skills] add automated feedback submission (#112)
commits.summary: Added a command and guidance for submitting specific, actionable feedback about the skill.

commits.subject: [eas-simulator] argent remote install + dogfood gaps (#103)
commits.summary: Expanded controller and command guidance by allowing `argent`, noting POSIX-shell requirements on Windows, documenting `--json` behavior, and clarifying how to list system apps.

commits.subject: Organize skills with expo-* and eas-* (#98)
commits.summary: Revised the pricing notice to describe EAS Simulator as a hosted service whose session usage follows account pricing and limits.

commits.subject: Add eas-simulator skill (#88)
commits.summary: Created the initial EAS Simulator skill, covering remote iOS/Android sessions, prerequisites, operating modes, controller commands, and cleanup.
